[quote=indonocaismnic;59265425][i][b]Indonocaismnic has requested to send peacekeeping forces[/b] 

About 55,600 peacekeeping forces from Indonocaismnic will send those who are muslim and will help assist Hydronia to defend the holy city, since Mecca is an important center for the majority of Muslims in Indonocaismnic. We have a call for a joint operation with Hydronia in the defense with the support of the navy, air, and land. Al-Jakay Special Forces will also be sent to give intel about any movement of  Sal-Baliz. For land, the government has assigned 4 M1A1/M1A2 Abrams, 30 K2 Black Panthers, and 20 Altay tanks.  5  M109 Self-Propelled Howitzers, 50 Otokar Cobra II,  80 Humvee, 36 Stryker, 20 Caesar Self-Propelled Howitzers, 4 M777A2, 6 M142 HIMARS, and 20 MARS II will help assist in deafening the holy city. For air, Indonocaismnic has requested air support of  5 British Aerospace Harrier II, 3 A-10/OA-10 Thunderbolt II, 10 F/A-18 Hornet, 4 Eurofighter Typhoon, and 10 McDonnell Douglas F-15. 6 T129 ATAK, 3 Eurocopter Tiger, and 5 AH-64 Apache will be deployed to assist the support. For transport, 5 A400M Atlas, 3 Transall C-160, and 2 C-17 Globemaster III, with additions of 4 CH-47 and 23 CH-53G. In the Navy, 2 Kongō-class destroyers, 1 Atago-class destroyer, and 1 Takanami-class destroyer have been reassigned, with 2 TCG Anadolu Carriers to the Agros Straits. General Officer of National Federation Armed Forces of Indonocaismnic and Peacekeeping Forces, Umar-alutrk, messages that this is not an invasion but support by fellow Muslims from Indonocaismnic to ensure peace and safety to all Muslims from the holy city. Hydronia gladly accept this offer. As many soldiers as possible will be required to defend the city. After much consideration, the parliament assembly has also authorised one more ship containing 5,000 troops to make the voyage to Mecca. This will take the total of Hydronian troops around Mecca to 12,000. The reasoning behind restraining the amount of troops is to not seem like any kind of invasion force. Hydronia does not have a large Muslim population, so the fear is that any more troops would provoke a negative response from the Islamic community.

Hydronia, I understand. If you want to involve more countries, involve more. But you do have a point about me not being on the map. Still, Asyla hopes that we can co-operate in the future.

[quote=united_hydronia;59264746][b]Protection of the Holy City[/b]

[i]After intercepting a Sal-Baliz communication seemingly confirming their ambitions to take Mecca, the Great Parliamentary Assembly authorized the movement of 7,000 troops from Gatonia base, Italian dutch to the area surrounding Mecca. Although this would be a major setback for the planned invasion of the Sal-Baliz, the assembly deemed it a necessary action in order to protect Mecca. The Hydronian Government has made it known to all the nations of Erene that it's intentions are not hostile. The government has also told all countries that they should advise their citizens to leave Mecca immediately, or stay within the boundaries of the city, as it is deemed unlikely that the Sal-Baliz will directly attack the city, due to it's prominent religious significance. Troops are being stationed around the boundaries of the city, but not within it.[/i]

General Eren Kurtulus sits in an empty room, thinking through the mission ahead. A knock on the door.
"Come in," he says, a stern look on his face. The captain of the UHS Nemesis enters the room.
"We've just landed on the coast of west shamat sir, your troops are ready for your orders,"
"thank you," Eren replies. He makes his way to where his soldiers are waiting to disembark the vessel. Eren gives them the usual quick pep talk, not wanting to waste time. Every second they spend on this ship is another second for the Sal-Baliz to make progress. The soldiers take their positions on various tanks and trucks. The smell of petrol wafts through the ship as an armada of engines start up simultaneously. As the vehicles exit the ship, the realisation of what they are about to do finally sinks into the general's mind. If they misaim one missile, slip up a single time, Hydronia would be doomed. If the holiest city of islam is damaged or taken by the Sal-Baliz, Hydronia will take the full blame, he will take the full blame. Eren puts the thougth out of his mind, knowing it will only hinder the mission.

4 long hours of travelling though the seemingly endless desert and the troops had finally arrived at Mecca. The city usually bustled with life, but this time the atmosphere was filled with fear and anticipation. As per the promise made by the Hydronian government, no soldier would step inside the city, only a perimiter would be made around it. The next 3 hours were spent organising the troops into said perimeter, awaiting the Sal-Baliz. Whilst this was happening, Hydronian helicopters and drones had surveyed the area between the Sal-Baliz and Mecca, searching for the soldiers that had been sent to capture the city. So far they had had no luck. As the sun set over the desert, the soldiers braced for the impact of what was to come, the first full-scale ground battle of this war, with the stakes higher than ever...
